objective: Create one text-free wide cyanotype editorial illustration called Confluence Field: two large asymmetric nested contour fields approach from opposite corners and partially overlap near the center, where exactly one cyan lens-shaped shared zone makes their supported relationship visible.

confirmed: Two distinct domains can retain separate layered identities while sharing one limited region.
The cyan overlap is the only confirmed shared region between the two domains.
The contour fields are an abstract editorial metaphor and do not represent real geography topology hardware architecture or data flow.
simplifications: Use one cohesive hero composition with no supporting view: one broad irregular contour field grows from lower-left and a different narrower contour field descends from upper-right.
Build each field from four to six nested opaque ivory terrace masses separated by thin deep-indigo contour channels; vary their curvature spacing and silhouette so they do not become parallel pipes.
Let the fields overlap only near center and form exactly one compact cyan lens or saddle-shaped shared zone; cyan occupies roughly five to eight percent of the canvas.
Use a few incomplete muted grid fragments and two or three pale construction arcs behind the hero as print context, never as a frame or second semantic layer.
Keep the outer silhouette open irregular and poster-like with shaped negative space around and between the two fields.
blocked: Do not imply a real map terrain watershed geology network architecture protocol compatibility rule physical law product or guarantee.
Do not copy the approved cover's radial quarter-cutaway concentric circular silhouette compact core two stacked supporting views or left title field.
Do not reuse any rejected concept's rectangular enclosure horizontal channels interface plate magnified component interwoven pipes or mechanical joint.
Do not draw a Venn diagram flowchart circuit cable pipe duct road ribbon bundle gasket seal connector hardware machine housing architectural floor plan or engineering component.
Do not add labels titles letters numbers dimensions arrows legends people hands borders shadows glow perspective isometric volume photorealistic texture or generated annotations.

composition.structure: wide 16:9 fully opaque premium cyanotype editorial poster on deep indigo paper; one irregular lower-left contour field and one different upper-right contour field together occupy roughly eighty percent of the frame; each field contains four to six nested opaque ivory terrace masses with crisp pale contour accents and deep-indigo channels; the two fields overlap at an off-center focal point to create exactly one compact cyan lens-shaped shared zone; use generous shaped negative space and only sparse incomplete grid fragments and construction arcs; no inset no panel no border and no title zone
composition.hierarchy: the two asymmetric ivory contour bodies form one dynamic diagonal hero silhouette; the compact cyan shared zone is the only saturated focal feature; strong outer contours quieter inner contours and faint background construction marks create three visible levels without literal pixel instructions; the image must read as an elegant finished editorial illustration at thumbnail size before it reads as technical
composition.human_elements: none; no people faces hands characters instructors narrators mascots or stock imagery

text_policy.mode: fully text-free generated cyanotype illustration with deterministic captions added outside the image if needed
